generations.name: First generation (PPE)
generations.notes: Launch on PPE, 800 V. Sportback (and Avant where sold) share the hardware. 100 kWh gross / 94.9 kWh usable, up to 270 kW DC; a smaller 83 / 75.8 kWh pack (225 kW) exists in Europe, check per variant. NRCan rates MY2025; EPA ratings start at MY2027. Confidence: medium-high (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Audi_A6_e-tron
